AC memory observation is separate from live transport; snapshots and polling are diagnostics only. No invented restrictions or permissions. Includes the complete pinned Dictionary source, typed PNAML bindings, PhaseNav and affect runtime/reference routing. Includes an executable source-kernel coupled phase stream (isolated model or actual caller-supplied frames); no native host claim from local tests. Pip is the singularity centre of the existing phase geometry; the full 36D state and typed register retain history. Includes exact reversible maps and local execution tests.
